observed_result.question: How do I rotate an API key without interrupting integrations?
observed_result.answer: To rotate an API key, create a second key, update every integration to use it, verify successful requests, and then revoke the old key. Two keys may remain active during a rotation. Revocation is immediate and cannot be undone. NorthstarFlow never displays the full secret again after the key creation screen closes.

citation.title: Rotate an API key without integration downtime

observed_result.question: Which workspace role is allowed to modify payment settings?
observed_result.answer: When a renewal card payment fails, NorthstarFlow emails the billing owner and provides a seven-day grace period. During the grace period, search remains available but new ingestion is paused after the first day. Update the card in Settings > Billing. Successful payment resumes ingestion without requiring a new workspace.
